newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus Airways quashes resignation talk.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus Airways quashes resignation talk.

text.p: Cyprus Airways on Friday dismissed news reports its executive chairman Vassilis Rologis had resigned to take up his new post as chairman of the Cypriot Chamber of Commerce and Industry.
"The report is unfounded and unsubstantiated," a statement from the airline, Cyprus's national carrier, said.

Rologis was elected chairman of the chamber on Thursday. Greek Cypriot newspaper Haravghi said Rologis tendered his resignation to President Glafcos Clerides two days ago, while other papers said Rologis was expected to resign in the next few days.
